The Software Support Engineer will investigate issues that span software, electrical systems, and mechanical components, then turn what you learn into tested fixes and better diagnostic tools. You’ll work closely with Software, Hardware, Deployment, and Field Service to resolve issues on deployed systems and improve future releases.
What You’ll Do
Troubleshoot software issues on production robots using system logs, controller telemetry, and hands-on testing.
Reproduce field failures in the lab and trace them across software, motors, sensors, actuators, and mechanical assemblies.
Develop, review, and deploy C++ fixes to software that interfaces with, controls, and integrates hardware.
Debug real-time control behavior, including how concurrent subsystems prioritize commands, respond to faults, and recover safely.
Validate fixes through bench testing, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and integrated robot testing before releasing them to the fleet.
Who You Are
Hands-on experience writing software that interfaces with and controls automation hardware (e.g. motors, actuators, sensors, displays, grippers, etc.)
An understanding of real-time control systems, including timing, command prioritization
Experience diagnosing problems at the intersection of software, electronics, and mechanical systems.
Familiarity with Git, code reviews, and validating software changes on physical hardware.
Clear communication skills and the ability to follow an issue from the initial report through a verified fix.
Nice to Have
Experience supporting a deployed fleet of robots, autonomous vehicles, industrial equipment, or other electromechanical systems.
Experience building or maintaining hardware-in-the-loop test setups.
Experience refactoring legacy procedural code into maintainable, object-oriented C++.
Why You’ll Love Working Here
Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team
Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total)
Meaningful stock options, so you share in the company's success as we grow
Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team!
